concept: Athena: serverless SQL queries on data in S3
tests: Choosing a service to run SQL directly on large volumes of data in S3 without loading into a DB and with no infrastructure.
expected: Amazon Athena — serverless, standard SQL on data in place in S3, pay per query. Triggers: "SQL queries directly against S3", "without loading into a database", "no infrastructure".
why_not: Redshift requires loading into a cluster; RDS isn't built to query S3; EMR requires a cluster.
